rules.text: The ascendant’s lord sits in the 12th sign from the ascendant: a tendency to spend freely and to leave home.
A benefic in the 4th house, in a benefic’s star and a benefic’s sub: the native is true, reliable and sincere.
The Sun rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (ruby) and colour may be used.
The Moon rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (pearl) and colour may be used.
Mars rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (coral) and colour may be used.
Mercury rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (emerald) and colour may be used.
Jupiter rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (topaz) and colour may be used.
Venus rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (diamond) and colour may be used.
Saturn rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (sapphire) and colour may be used.
Rahu rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (agate or turquoise) and colour may be used.
Ketu rules the sub of the ascendant or the 11th cusp and signifies none of 6, 8 and 12, so its gem (agate or turquoise) and colour may be used.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Aries. Changes views suddenly, is dogmatic, quick to lose temper and impulsive. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Taurus. Stubborn, reserved, slow to forgive and somewhat fatalistic, with a dislike of hard work. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Gemini. Restless, slow to decide and impatient to see results at once. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Cancer. Imagines slights, is moody, worries over money and does not forgive easily. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Leo. Ambition without limit, favouritism, extravagance and pride. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Virgo. Over-critical, talkative and full of self-doubt, apt to neglect family for work. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Libra. Led by emotions, mixes business with pleasure, spends on dress and is easily swayed by the other sex. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Scorpio. Over-rates oneself, is sarcastic, quick-tempered and must beware of drink. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Sagittarius. Selfish, wasteful and apt to marry in haste. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Capricorn. Over-ambitious for money and power, and apt to overwork. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Aquarius. Seeks solitude, is unconventional and wavers in decisions. These are the faults to correct.
The star lord of the ascendant’s sub lord is in Pisces. Broods, is timid, asks advice and then ignores it, and drifts in romance. These are the faults to correct.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is Mars, linked with Mercury: apt to speak untruth.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is Saturn, linked with Mercury: apt to hide news and leave things out.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is Venus: a peacemaker.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is Venus, linked with Mercury: a clever peacemaker who sees the strengths and weaknesses of both sides.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is the Sun: does his duty nobly and never lies.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is Mars or in a Mars star: a spendthrift.
With that Mars link to the 2nd sub lord, Mars also signifies the 10th: earns more and also spends more.
The 2nd cusp’s sub lord is Saturn: economical with money.
Jupiter, lord of the 2nd, is in the 11th: gains come by lawful means.
Saturn, lord of the 2nd, is in the 11th: profit may come by fair means or foul.
The lord of the 3rd is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss, waste or hidden hostility through neighbours, cousins, short journeys or publishing.
The lord of the 4th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss through mother, vehicles, change of residence, building or broken studies.
The 5th cusp’s sub lord is in the star of a planet in Leo or Aquarius: can become a popular musician; Venus adds to success in music.
The star lord of the 5th sub lord is linked with the Moon and Venus: a taste for music and the wish to improve the talent.
The star lord of the 5th sub lord is linked with Venus and Mercury: intelligent enough to compose songs for musicians.
In music: the star lord of the 5th cusp’s sub lord is in Gemini or Sagittarius, so the native can render music that appeals to the audience.
In music: the star lord of the 5th cusp’s sub lord is in Cancer or Capricorn, so the native enjoys music as a listener (Saturn predominant).
In music: the star lord of the 5th cusp’s sub lord is in Aries or Libra, so the native can change rhythm and pitch at the right moment.
In music: the star lord of the 5th cusp’s sub lord is in Virgo or Pisces, so the native can blend notes and produce harmony.
The lord of the 5th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss through visitors, companions, music, children, speculation or pleasures.
The lord of the 7th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss through litigation, a partner or the spouse.
The lord of the 8th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss by paying heavy interest on borrowed money.

rules.topic: Father, fortune, higher learning and abroad
rules.text: The lord of the 9th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: expense through strangers, father, long journeys or higher studies.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are both the Sun: suited to government service, defence, or surgical work.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Sun and the Moon: suited to the navy, boilers and steam engines, or nursing in surgical wards.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Sun and Mars: suited to military service at the front.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Sun and Mercury: suited to posts, telegraph, telephone and communications.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Sun and Jupiter: suited to education, law, judges, religious endowments, finance and banking.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Sun and Venus: suited to transport, the air force, music, medicine, chemicals or veterinary work.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Sun and Saturn: suited to mines, metals, coal, jail staff, watchmen or night duty.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Moon and Mars: suited to the navy, seafaring, or petroleum products.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Moon and Mercury: suited to interpreters, secretaries, marine engineers and messengers.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Moon and Jupiter: suited to physicians, overseas banking and foreign exchange.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Moon and Venus: suited to painting, dairy, toiletries, silk, ladies’ tailoring, nursing and catering.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are the Moon and Saturn: suited to well digging, lake bunds, geology, petrol and oil pumps.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are Mercury and Jupiter: suited to councillors, clergy, advertising, the press, and bank accounts.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are Mercury and Venus: suited to music, radio, sanitary or automobile engineering, and the arts.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are Mercury and Saturn: suited to handwriting and fingerprint experts, mining engineers and geologists.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are Jupiter and Venus: suited to tax tribunals, law courts, the food department, agriculture and fertilisers.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are Jupiter and Saturn: suited to philosophy, politics, and trusteeship of estates.
Aries on the 10th cusp, and the 10th sub lord and its star lord are Venus and Saturn: suited to leather, skins and hides, and slaughter houses.
The 10th cusp’s sub lord is in the star of a planet in Aries: drawn to the army, police or fire service, or to work with fire, metal and sharp tools; a planner and pioneer rather than a subordinate.
The 10th cusp is in a Venus star: the work has a Venus nature (Krishnamurti’s example: photography).
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 1: gains by own efforts and personal contact; independent, a good organiser who acts in person.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 2: banking, currency, auditing or handling public funds.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 3: journalism, publishing, transport, posts, sales or drafting.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 4: an office at home, lodging, interior decoration, real estate or brokerage.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 5: the stock exchange, cinema, child care, toys or children’s books.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 6: labour or public-health work, medical relief, repairs or deposits.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 7: a judge, public relations, arbitration, an embassy or marriage brokering (guard against theft).
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 8: partnership, legacies, pension papers, taxes or insurance (do not speculate).
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 9: foreign trade, a university or religious places.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 10: one’s own business, steady advancement or politics.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 11: politics, clubs, the legislature or an ambassador’s post.
Aries ascendant with the Sun as the 10th sub lord, signifying house 12: working alone or behind the scenes: jails, hospitals, asylums, research or secret work (speculation ruins).

The lord of the 7th or a planet in the 7th (its chief significators) is in Saturn’s sub: a drawback for business, with opposition and loss in public dealings. (Western books blame Saturn in the 7th instead.)
The 7th cusp’s sub lord is in the 5th, 8th or 12th house in an earthy sign: business brings loss.
The lord of the 7th or a planet in the 7th is in the sub of a planet that occupies the 5th or is in the star of a planet in 5, 8 or 12: a business may be wound up through loss.
The lord of the 10th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss through change in service, or paying for promotion.
The lord of the 3rd is in the 11th: gains through brothers (a Saturn lord makes the brother careful, a Mars lord lavish), shown in its periods.
The lord of the 5th is in the 11th: gains through speculation, cinema, pleasures or children in its periods.
The lord of the 11th is in the sub of the ascendant’s lord: a sincere, lasting friend who helps materially.
The lord of the 11th is in the star or sub of the lord of the 2nd: money and gain through friends, and their support when low.
The lord of the 11th is in the star or sub of the lord of the 3rd: friends made on short journeys or by letter, often for a short time.
The lord of the 11th is in the star or sub of the lord of the 3rd, who also rules the 12th: such a friend may later turn cheat and secret enemy.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 4th or 9th: avoid friends ruled by those lords; they take and are not grateful.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 5th: one loses to such friends and they gain, more so if that lord also rules 8 or 12.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 6th: the friend gives and the native gains.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 7th, 8th or 9th: friends cannot be relied on; they serve their own time.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 10th: most helpful and faithful friends who spread one’s name; reputation grows.
The lord of the 11th is in its own star: lasting and useful friends.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: beware of secret enemies, especially people born in that lord’s stars.
Ketu in the 11th is not auspicious for friendship: cheating by friends.
The lord of the 11th is in the star of the lord of the 12th: loss through an elder brother, a friend, or a son- or daughter-in-law.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: Jupiter or Venus is in the star of the lord of the 12th: pleasant expenses, purchases and investment in land, buildings or business.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The lord of the 12th is a malefic (Mars or Saturn): a planet in its star ends in loss, whatever houses it owns or occupies.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The 12th cusp’s sub lord is Mars, linked with Jupiter: over-liberal, spending well beyond income.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The Moon is in the 7th or rules it, and planets sit in the Moon’s stars: in their periods there are chances to give generously.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The Moon is in Saturn’s sub: the mind can concentrate and meditate. (Krishnamurti rejects the Western test of Saturn sextile the ascendant.)

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: Saturn in the 3rd: spiritual practice meets interruptions.
Judge from the exact ascendant and the house cusps, never from the Moon sign, even when the ascendant is afflicted. Krishnamurti dropped the Moon-sign option after his research on twins.
All twelve cusps count. The sub lord of a cusp settles whether the matters of that house will happen; the significators of the house show when.
A classical conjunction yoga is also met by one planet whose sign lord, star lord and sub lord are the planets of that conjunction. It then gives the yoga’s results in its own periods.
A planet’s own nature shows how a result comes (Jupiter by lawful means, Saturn by crooked ones). The houses whose cusps fall in its signs show the source: through whom or what the result arrives.
A planet gives mainly the results of the houses owned by the lord of the star it occupies. A planet well placed by sign can still give loss if its star lord rules the 12th.
The sub lord of a planet decides whether its promise is enjoyed: in a favourable sub the native realises the result; in an unfavourable sub its periods bring denial, delay or anxiety.
A planet placed in the 6th, 8th or 12th sign from a sign it owns spoils the matters of that house; elsewhere it supports them. The effect shows in its own periods.

A planet that owns a good house and a bad one gives both results, in different sub-periods of its dasa; one does not cancel the other. Krishnamurti rejects splitting its dasa into a first and second half by house.
A yoga works only in the joint periods of its planets, so those periods must come within one’s lifetime. A node joined with a yoga planet, or links with the lords of 6, 8 or 12, dilute it.
No other person’s chart changes the native’s results: a lucky spouse or a child’s birth cannot alter one’s own promise. Each chart shows the same event from its own side.
A relative’s matters are read by counting from that relative’s house. For a husband’s transfer, take 3, 9 and 12 counted from the 7th, that is the 9th, 3rd and 6th of the wife’s chart.

Tradition holds that kendra, kona and 6/8 (shashtashtaka) relations decide results; Krishnamurti rejects this because a native rose and married in the joint periods of planets 6/8 apart. Judge by star and sub lords.

Tradition (Phaladeepika) gives the results of each house lord’s dasa by exaltation, own sign or enemy sign; Krishnamurti says these rules fail and judges a period by its star lord and sub lord instead.

Tradition holds that Saturn transiting the 8th, the 4th, or the Moon sign (Sade Sati) brings misfortune; Krishnamurti rejects judging it alone, because the running periods and their stellar links decide.
Tradition uses ashtakavarga points for prediction; Krishnamurti rejects it because the sign-to-sign counts come out the same for twins and for births 40 minutes apart.
